scope: Completed exploratory direct GENI measurements; conversation RAM and disk caches are disabled in these arms. These are not the protected HTTP acceptance measurements.

method.aggregate: Median of per-request token rates; short EOS outputs are marked non-comparable.

direct_settings.warning_note: The harness expects reserve 700 and inspects an earlier duplicate cache flag; actual reserve is 750 and the final RAM-cache flag is zero.

cpu_reference.cases: Selected gate/up formats, token-group widths 1 through 8, cancellation, and seven subnormal-product magnitudes.

real_cache_affinity_smoke.method: Actual authenticated RAM-cache A/B/A requests. Trace each temporary conversation-file open and rename; check the same writer thread affinity syscall. Trace data is not used as performance evidence.

failed_tests.name: ple_parity
failed_tests.cause: Required legacy Q2_0 table/capture path is unavailable.

failed_tests.name: kv_stream_parity
failed_tests.cause: The test incorrectly dispatches hybrid K8V4 zeroing through the FP16 branch; cudaMemset receives a null k_pool. Hybrid append_batch and comparison helpers also lack hybrid branches. This is a test-only defect. Production hybrid dispatch is complete.
failed_tests.protected_int8_result: 306 random batches, ring restore, and batch-versus-step pass bitwise; zero failures.

failed_tests.name: expert_multi_test
failed_tests.cause: This test requires AVX512-VNNI and AVX512-VBMI; the Ryzen 5 3600 does not provide them.

built_ctest.initial_attempt: Only selected targets were built. Build all missing executables before the reported complete attempt.

real_model_experts.note: The full expert operations pass the existing test tolerance; this is not a claim of bit-exact model generation.

nvme_ple_selftest.location: Owned temporary directory on the same NVMe mount as the production table; removed after the run.

image.input: 112x112 solid red PNG; text asks only the image color and does not name it

runtime_log.ple_backing: Direct SSD reader on the NVMe mount; SSD keep-alive reads active. No RAM-table override.
runtime_log.note: Sanitized values from the current installed engine start; no private log paths or historical user request text are published.

protected_http.method: Authenticated HTTP; original cache budgets; fresh owned L3 directories on the same NVMe device; seed 20261010; three repeats per target; 256 output tokens per request. Service stopped and no other benchmark or build runs at the same time.

delivery_scope.approved: Publish verified correctness and bounded-cache fixes with the measured mixed gains and regressions.
delivery_scope.performance_claim: No general speedup and no 20 percent claim.

method.store_initialization: Each arm copies the same pre-seeded owned NVMe store.
method.protected_settings: IQ3_S mixed native experts; INT8 KV; 524288 logical context; vision; MTP window 8, min_p 0.70; L2 15360 MiB/32 slots; L3 50 GiB; NVMe-backed PLE.
method.first_pair_engine_metrics: Discarded: the initial helper selected the oldest history row. Direct HTTP timings remain valid. Null metric fields represent unavailable data.
method.candidate_builds: The first two candidate arms precede the final identity-copy allocation guards and compatible root-park diagnostic. The final candidate arm uses the installed engine hash. Initial candidate hashes were not retained.
method.scope: Shared-root returns improve in this sample. Other measured cases do not establish a general latency or throughput gain.
